name: Rainbow Heights Academy: Year 1
source:
You are the newest member of the AGG book club.

Members of this book club are known to read
the latest and most riveting books that they can get their hands on

They soon stumble across a strange book called "The Fractured Oath"

The book synopsis reads...
"When Tyler Lee decides to risk it all to get the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity
to attend the most prestigious school in the country,
He soon realizes that he may have bitten off more than he could chew.
Whether he rises to the challenge or accepts defeat,
That'll be solely up to you!"

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2100460/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是AGG读书俱乐部的最新成员。

众所周知，这个读书俱乐部的成员会阅读
他们可以获得的最新、最吸引人的书籍

他们很快偶然发现了一本奇怪的书，名叫《破碎的誓言》该书的概要如下：…
“当泰勒·李决定冒一切风险去获得千载难逢的机会时
就读国内最负盛名的学校，
他很快意识到自己可能已经贪多嚼不烂了。
无论他迎接挑战还是接受失败，
这完全取决于你！”

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2100460/]Steam[/url]]
